sm: This episode of Poets From the Neighborhood, hosted by Viraja Ar and Catherine Adams, presents poems by local writers. The poems include Insomniac by Francesca Kirkpatrick, about sleepless nights, angels and writing as a response to insomnia. Night Fright and Halloween Visitor by Rebecca Yancy follow, then Petition by Susie Sims Urban, a plea about taking more than one gives, and Who Seeks by S.R. Lee. The hosts close with Dream Catcher, a poem by Viraja about soft feathers catching dreams and letting through only smiles, laughter and loveliness.
